summary: Conviction under IPC s.302/149 challenged; unlawful assembly insufficient (only 4 guilty, not 5 under s.141 IPC); procedural flaws in contradiction/omission recording under CrPC s.162/164, Evidence Act s.145; prior statements not properly reconciled; High Court reappreciation erroneous; conviction quashed due to lack of s.149 applicability.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code 1860 s.302, s.149, s.141
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.162, s.164
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction under s.302/149 IPC quashed; High Court judgment set aside; accused no.5's acquittal upheld; other convictions modified as not liable under s.149 (to be considered under s.34 IPC).
